# Protected paths for the upstream sync system (tools/sync-upstream.sh)
#
# Each line is a path (file or directory) relative to the repo root that
# contains YOUR personal customizations. During an upstream sync, these
# paths are always restored to your version after merging in changes from
# cotes2020/jekyll-theme-chirpy, so the design/security updates never
# overwrite your environment settings, content, or branding.
#
# - Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored.
# - Add a new line whenever you create a file/folder you don't want the
#   upstream theme sync to touch.

_config.yml
_data
.well-known

favicon.ico
